prayerExcerpt.en-US: Happy are you, holy Virgin Mary, deserving of all praise; from you rose the sun of justice, Christ the Lord.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Maria, alegra-te, ó cheia de graça, o Senhor é contigo; és bendita entre todas as mulheres da terra!

meta.face: The image's own face, not the set's Our Lady: a young Mexican woman of about sixteen with warm olive-brown skin and a small, softly OVAL, slightly elongated face — a straight, gentle nose, lowered dark eyes under fine dark brows, a small closed mouth with a faint serene smile, a smooth rounded chin; straight dark-brown hair parted in the centre and falling beneath the mantle; her head tilted to her right. The angel below: a small child's face with a round chin and short dark curls, looking out.
meta.basis: A Marian title shows its own image: the tilma of 1531 kept at the Basilica of Guadalupe (olive-skinned young woman inclined to her right, hands joined, rose tunic with floral pattern and dark sash, star-strewn blue-green mantle, crescent moon borne by an angel with eagle-feathered wings, golden rays).
